title: Union Budget fiscal deficit
definition: The excess of total Union Government expenditure over total non-debt receipts (revenue receipts plus recovery of loans and other receipts).

sources.publisher: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
sources.title: Budget at a Glance 2026-2027

points.evidence: Page 1, Budget at a Glance table, row 'Fiscal Deficit': FY 2024-25 (Actuals) is 1574431 crore INR.
Page 1, Budget at a Glance table, row 'Fiscal Deficit': FY 2025-26 (Revised Estimates) is 1558492 crore INR.
points.estimate_method: Ministry of Finance Revised Estimates for FY 2025-26.

points.evidence: Page 1, Budget at a Glance table, row 'Fiscal Deficit': FY 2026-27 (Budget Estimates) is 1695768 crore INR.
points.estimate_method: Ministry of Finance Budget Estimates for FY 2026-27.
